about: demo/want-finders, frozen before its first scored run: each file's SHA-256, held by test_want_finders.py. The wants, their right cards and the hit rule are in these two files; a change to either is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
hit_rule: a want with right cards hits at k when one of them is among the first k names the finder offers, in its order, at most 5; a want with no right card hits when nothing is offered

rules.R1: hits at 1, over the wants with right cards
rules.R5: hits at 5, over the wants with right cards
rules.R0: the wants with no right card that were offered nothing

before_the_freeze: the ten wants were asked by hand of suggest, similar and the canvas's search on 2026-11-16 before this freeze, by the agent session that wrote them; the README says what was seen
